assertions.assertion: Subclasses DefaultScopeParser (or implements IScopeParser) and overrides ParseScopeValue(ParseScopeContext)
assertions.rationale: Implements IScopeParser directly with the interface's ParseScopeValues(IEnumerable<string>) method — a valid alternative the assertion explicitly allows — though it does not use the ParseScopeValue(ParseScopeContext) override path.

assertions.assertion: Uses scopeContext.SetParsedValues(name, parameter) for the parameterized scope and SetError/SetIgnore for other cases
assertions.rationale: Does not use SetParsedValues/SetError/SetIgnore; instead builds ParsedScopesResult by adding ParsedScopeValue/ParsedScopeValidationError objects manually, so the specified ParseScopeContext API is absent.

assertions.assertion: Registers the parser via AddScopeParser<T>() on the IdentityServer builder
In IProfileService reads context.RequestedResources.ParsedScopes.FirstOrDefault(x => x.ParsedName == "transaction") and uses its ParsedParameter
assertions.rationale: The profile service reads context.RequestedScopes and manually substrings the raw 'transaction:' string rather than using RequestedResources.ParsedScopes with ParsedName/ParsedParameter.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT define the parameterized value as a static ApiScope name
assertions.rationale: Registers only the base 'transaction' ApiScope; the parameter is provided per request, not as a static scope.
